IIT Bombay students protest Sahil Wakode's death with hunger strike

Students at IIT Bombay have initiated a hunger strike following the death of Sahil Wakode. Protesters are demanding the resignation of the institute's director and the formation of an external panel to investigate Wakode's death. The strike began after Wakode's passing.
